description: The closed sets from the enforcing packages — T11's finalised descriptor: publish CHOICES with i18n label keys and the daemon's own confirmation statements, roles, the plan validator's OWN caps, templates, the remote-create gate as read WITH the sentence a closed gate speaks, routeAvailable, the workspace root with its state.

publish.label: wizard.publish.private.label
publish.statement: publish PRIVATE creates a remote repository visible only to the accounts you add — nothing is published to the world, but the content leaves this machine.

publish.label: wizard.publish.public.label
publish.statement: publish PUBLIC creates a repository visible to the whole world — every file and its full history become outward publication of your content, readable by anyone, and deleting the repository afterwards does not un-publish what was seen. It needs the confirm-public word, and the daemon refuses without it.

result.remoteCreateReason: intake.allowRemoteCreate is off — a person must switch it on (the settings door) before any repository is created
